mutants.label: [selection] the test files a spec runs are not its inputs
mutants.why: Killed by the test-file-changed case and the test-directory case: deleting the killing test is the other silent way a tooth goes.

mutants.label: [selection] a changed file beneath a directory input does not count
mutants.why: Killed by the test-directory case: skill-script specs name a tests directory, not files.

mutants.label: [selection] the spec's own file is not an input
mutants.why: Killed by the spec-itself-changed case: a re-anchored or new row must run.

mutants.label: [base] an unresolvable base reads as no change
mutants.why: Killed by the unresolvable-base test: a typo or unfetched ref would pass every spec unrun.

mutants.label: [base] the diff is taken from the base's tip, not the merge-base
mutants.why: Killed by the base-moved test: a branch behind its base would be charged for the base's own edits.

mutants.label: [base] the diff is against HEAD, not the working tree
mutants.why: Killed by the uncommitted-edit test: locally the gate runs before the commit.

mutants.label: [cwd] every spec runs from the repo root
mutants.why: Killed by the machinery-style test: its suite is only found from its own directory, so the baseline goes red and the gate fails a killed mutant.

mutants.label: [cwd] the repo root is tried before the spec's own directory
mutants.why: Killed by the bare-tests test and the repo-wide cwd test: a bare `tests` exists at the root too, and the skill spec means its own.

mutants.label: [cwd] a bare word that exists is not a path argument
mutants.why: Killed by the bare-tests test (its spec runs from the root, scores nothing, and a killed mutant reads as a survivor) and the repo-wide cwd test.
mutants.find: if not a.startswith("-") and ("/" in a or any((c / a).exists() for c in candidates))
mutants.replace: if not a.startswith("-") and "/" in a

mutants.label: [verdict] a failing runner does not fail the spec
mutants.why: Killed by the drift test: the survivor's spec must be reported FAIL and the gate must exit 1.

mutants.label: [verdict] failed specs exit 0
mutants.why: Killed by the drift test, which asserts the exit status.
mutants.find:
print(f"\nteeth specs whose mutants did not all die: {', '.join(failed)}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
mutants.replace:
print(f"\nteeth specs whose mutants did not all die: {', '.join(failed)}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 0

mutants.label: [verdict] the survivor's label is dropped from the report
mutants.why: Killed by the drift test, which asserts the full label (the runner's own table truncates it to 30 characters).

mutants.label: [discovery] finding no specs passes
mutants.why: Killed by the no-specs test: a broken pathspec would gate nothing forever.

mutants.label: [wiring] the test target no longer runs check-teeth-changed
[wiring] check-teeth-changed diffs against a hard-coded base
mutants.why: Killed by the wiring test's VERSION_BASE assertion: a PR into dev must be judged on its own changes.

mutants.label: [empty] a change touching no spec input fails the gate
mutants.why: Killed by the runs-nothing test: two thirds of merges select nothing and must pass without a run, with the anchor gate still covering every spec.

mutants.why: The summary count line is informational: no test pins its wording, and the verdict is the exit status plus the RUN/FAIL/ok lines, which this does not touch. Inert on every path the suite reaches.
